expectations.text: Claude produces a Mermaid diagram showing the Django apps and their relationships
expectations.evidence: Full flowchart TD diagram showing accounts, orders, payments, their views/services/models, FK relationships, shared DB, and the signals seam.

expectations.text: Claude asks one question after presenting the diagram, not multiple
expectations.evidence: 'Walk me through this — explain what you see.' — single question. Interrogation noted as starting after engineer responds.

expectations.text: The interrogation probes WHY the system is shaped the way it is, not just WHAT it does
expectations.evidence: Notes interrogation will cover 'dependency direction, ownership, and async vs sync design decisions' — all WHY-focused categories.

expectations.text: Claude does not move to orient or pseudocode before the exit condition is met
expectations.evidence: Skill ends at the diagram + first question. No orient invocation, no pseudocode, no implementation guidance offered.
